name: pictures-map-one-right
description: Find and show (chat/pictures.rs): "get me a map of all the treasures" in a made-up game, so no model knows the answer. The wiki page has five pictures: concept art, a map of another area, the treasure map, a night screenshot and an armour set. The treasure map is p3 (the third on the page). Its alt text says only "Fort Joy" (the caption says what it is), while the wrong area's map says "map". It must show that one and nothing else. The stand-in pictures carry their words written on them, so a model that looks can tell them apart. Stand-in web.

pages.https://emberfall.example/wiki/Fort_Joy:
Fort Joy

Fort Joy is the island prison where Emberfall starts. You wake on the beach below the keep. Treasure is hidden in the beach caves, the ghetto and the cellars under the keep; most chests need a lockpick or a shovel.
